claim: Writing a Z80 DMA WR4 byte with 'interrupt control follows' (91) locks the Next DMA until power-off; do not port such code onto the zxnDMA.
limit: Only byte 91 tested; hard reset untested.

evidence.text: Issue 2 board, core 3.03.00: after WR4 byte 91 then 87 every later transfer failed; six C3 resets, A3, AF, 8B did not recover it, only power-off.
